name: Cell count
description: Works out how many cells are alive from a live and dead count, and how concentrated the culture is.
author: Acme Bio

operations.title: Cell viability
operations.description: Gives the percentage of live cells from a live and a dead count. Use it for any trypan blue or automated cell count.

operations.title: Seeding volume
operations.description: Works out how much of a culture to add to reach a target number of live cells per well.

inputs.name: live_per_ml
inputs.description: Live cells per millilitre in the culture.

inputs.name: cells_per_well
inputs.description: Live cells wanted in each well.
